Data Binding

Anza engines bind backend data (Rust Serde structs, Python dataclasses, TypeScript objects) to {{token}} placeholders. Values are converted to strings and inserted without HTML escaping.

What You Get

LanguageEngine PackageBinding Mechanism
RustanzaDirect serde::Serialize structs & serde_json::Value
Pythonanza@dataclass, Pydantic models, or standard dict
TypeScript@anzaui/engineTyped Record<string, unknown> and plain objects

Rust Engine Binding

In Rust, any struct deriving serde::Serialize can be passed to Template::render:

use anza::Setup; use serde::Serialize; #[derive(Serialize)] struct Article { id: i64, slug: String, title: String, summary: String, author: String, created: String, } let engine = Setup::new("templates").run()?; let article = Article { id: 42, slug: "zero-js-architecture".into(), title: "Zero-JS Architecture with STUI".into(), summary: "How server-templated components eliminate frontend bundle bloat.".into(), author: "Elena Vance".into(), created: "2026-08-28".into(), }; // Render component template let html = engine.get("feed/card.html")?.render(&article)?;

Python Engine Binding

In Python, pass dataclasses, Pydantic models or dicts; attributes are read by name:

from dataclasses import dataclass from anza import Setup @dataclass class Article: id: int slug: str title: str summary: str author: str created: str engine = Setup(root="templates").run() article = Article( id=42, slug="zero-js-architecture", title="Zero-JS Architecture with STUI", summary="How server-templated components eliminate frontend bundle bloat.", author="Elena Vance", created="2026-08-28" ) html = engine.get_template("feed/card.html").bind(article)

TypeScript Engine Binding

In TypeScript (Node.js, Deno, Bun, or Cloudflare Workers), bind typed objects with @anzaui/engine:

import { Setup } from '@anzaui/engine'; interface Article { id: number; slug: string; title: string; summary: string; author: string; created: string; } const engine = await new Setup({ root: './templates' }).run(); const article: Article = { id: 42, slug: 'zero-js-architecture', title: 'Zero-JS Architecture with STUI', summary: 'How server-templated components eliminate frontend bundle bloat.', author: 'Elena Vance', created: '2026-08-28' }; const html = engine.get('feed/card.html').bind(article);

Slotted Child Composition

When combining parent and child templates, pass the rendered child strings into the parent's data payload:

// 1. Render all feed cards let card = engine.get("feed/card.html")?; let cards_html: String = articles .iter() .map(|a| card.render(a)) .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()? .join("\n"); // 2. Render the "/" page with the cards bound into {{articles}}; // Page also binds layout/shell.html with the page in {{content}} let full_doc = Page::new("/") .param("title", "Home — Anza Blog") .param("description", "High-performance STUI blog powered by Anza.") .param("count", articles.len().to_string()) .param("articles", cards_html) .run(&engine)?;
